Bid Summary.value: The State of Maryland Treasurer's Office (issued by Tamaira Hawkins, thawkins@treasurer.state.md.us, 410-260-7533) is seeking 30 Dell Latitude 5550 laptops with extended 3-year warranty and 30 Dell Thunderbolt 4 Docks (WD22TB4), with specifications including Intel Core Ultra 5 processor, 16GB DDR5 RAM, 256GB SSD, and Windows 11 Pro. Proposals must be submitted electronically through the State's eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA) system by June 10, 2024 at 2:00 PM EDT, remain valid for 90 days after the due date, and delivery is required within 45 days of award. Required documentation includes Mercury Affidavit, Contract Affidavit for drug and alcohol-free workplace certification, Letter of Authorization from Dell, proof of delivery with serial numbers, and estimated ship dates. The bid utilizes the Desktop, Laptop and Tablet 2015 Master Contract (060B5400007).
